We follow the standard evaluation for unsupervised parsing: given a predicted parsing tree, we fetch all of its subtrees (nested constituents), and compare with those from the gold tree to compute the F1 score. We also report recall scores of the typed constituents in gold trees, including noun (NP), verb (VP), prepositional (PP), adjective (ADJ), adverb (ADV) phrases and subordinate clauses (SBAR).
